patch.value: GH-720: diagnose unbuilt GitHub extension sources and recommend resolvable npm artifacts

GitHub extension installation copies a source tree without building it, then reports only a missing manifest entry when TypeScript repositories omit committed dist output. Detect this source-shape mismatch, explain that GitHub installs are source copies, recommend the exact npm package command when safely derivable, document author expectations, and retain fail-closed source integrity.

A GitHub source with a missing manifest entry reports the copy-without-build cause without executing untrusted package scripts; When package metadata identifies a published package, remediation includes the exact npm source command; otherwise it recommends a locally built path; Extension author and install documentation distinguish GitHub source trees from built npm artifacts; Temporary-repository acceptance covers missing dist, committed dist, npm fallback, and bounded error output
